_header.what: Application Kit data for the sample student: documents to gather, form fields (with safe persona values), step list, deadline and official source for each best-matching scholarship. Draft: nothing here is verified yet.
_header.owner: Aman Kumar. Commit this file to team/aman/application-kits.json from your own git account, after you verify it.
_header.lookout_feature: Application Kit (PRD P0-10, MILESTONES Stage 4). The kit drawer renders these; Stage 3's server/src/kit/buildKit.js uses the documents/steps here instead of generic 'usually needed' items.
_header.shape: Each entry in kits[] follows the ApplicationKit shape in docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md (id, opportunityId, title, deadline, daysLeft, sourceUrl, applyUrl, documents[], fields[], steps[], safety, generatedFrom). Authoring-only fields added on top: category, deadline_reason, read_on, verified, needs_verification, field_labels_needs_verification, steps_sources[], notes[]. Strip them (or ignore them) when emitting kit.ready.
_header.how_this_draft_was_made: Prepared for the team on 2026-10-24 from live TinyFish Fetch/Search reads of the official pages listed in each entry (plus docs/RECON_FINDINGS.md). daysLeft is counted from 2026-10-24. Anything not read from a real page is marked needs_verification: true.
_header.safety: Read-only and prefill-only. Lookout never submits forms and never asks for, enters or stores passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar numbers. Every sensitive field has value null and is marked sensitive: true. Do not add real IDs, account numbers, passwords or OTPs to this file, not even as examples.
verify_before_commit: Every deadline against the official page on the day you commit (NSP dates can be extended).
Every documents[] item marked needs_verification: true (HDFC, ServiceScape and Tata Pankh document lists were NOT on the pages read; open each sub-scheme's 'View Details' page).
The applyUrl for MahaDBT 2.0 (the site returned proxy_error twice; we could not read it).
PM YASASVI College: whether the student's institute is on the notified 'Top Class' list (the list itself was not read).
PM-USP CSSS: the FAQ line about renewal for technical degrees, which seems to contradict the guideline (see notes in that entry).
Field labels in fields[] are generic (the real forms are behind login). Check them against what the portal shows after you log in yourself.

tasks_for_owner: Open every sourceUrl and every documents[].from link and check each item against the official page. Fix anything that is wrong.
Set verified: true on an entry ONLY after you have checked all of it yourself. Leave it false otherwise.
For items with needs_verification: true, either confirm them from an official page (add the URL and the read_on date, set needs_verification: false) or delete them.

Add 2 or more schemes that are missing (ideas: a Vidyasaarathi scheme open to Maharashtra B.Tech students when one opens; an AICTE scheme the persona qualifies for; a MahaDBT DTE scheme for OBC students if one exists). Use the template entry.
Keep every sensitive field's value null. Never paste real Aadhaar numbers, bank details, passwords or OTPs.
Keep this file in step with team/aman/eligibility-rules.json (same ids).

kits.title: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme Of Top Class Education In College For OBC, EBC And DNT Students

documents.name: Income certificate (family income up to Rs 2.50 lakh)
Caste certificate (OBC)
Admission rank (entrance exam rank, e.g. JEE Main for NITs/IIITs per Annexure-I)
Fee details (fee receipt / fee structure from the institute)
Bank account in the student's own name (details entered on NSP by the student)
Affidavit to the institution: not the third sibling availing the scheme

fields.label: Aadhaar number
fields.note: Used by NSP for OTR. Enter on NSP yourself. Lookout never asks for, enters or stores it.

fields.label: OTP sent to your mobile
fields.note: Enter on NSP yourself. Lookout never asks for it.

fields.label: Bank account and IFSC
fields.note: Enter on NSP yourself. Lookout never asks for it.

steps: Check that your institute is on the notified 'Top Class' list for this scheme and has slots for your course. Only notified institutions are covered, and 2nd-year students get leftover slots only.
Get your One Time Registration (OTR) on NSP yourself. OTR is a 14-digit number generated from Aadhaar; CSC centres can do it for Rs 30.
Log in to NSP with your OTR and choose this scheme. You may apply for only ONE merit-based scheme in AY 2026-27 (this one and PM-USP CSSS are both merit-based).
Upload the income certificate and caste certificate, and enter your bank details, admission rank and fee details.
Submit before 31 Oct 2026. Your institute must verify by 15 Nov 2026.
Re-apply every year (renewal is not automatic).
kits.safety: Lookout never submits forms and never asks for, enters or stores passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar numbers.
notes: The guideline (6(ii)) says institute verification closes 31 Oct every year 'or the date decided by DBT Mission'; NSP shows 15-11-2026. We use NSP's date.
The notified institution list was not read. That is the biggest open question for this persona.

documents.name: Previous year marksheet (at least 50% marks)
documents.why: Renewal criterion, guideline 4(viii); FAQ: renewal applicants 'provide necessary marksheets'

documents.name: Proof of at least 75% attendance (verified by the institute)
Bank account in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded

fields.note: Enter on NSP yourself. Lookout never asks for it.

fields.label: Bank account and IFSC

steps: Only for students who got the FRESH CSSS award in 1st year. Fresh awards go by the Class XII board's top-20-percentile list, so a 2nd-year student cannot apply fresh.
Check you are NOT taking a state scholarship, fee waiver or reimbursement (e.g. MahaDBT OBC freeship). CSSS rule 4(iv) excludes those.
Log in to NSP with your OTR and open the renewal application.
Enter last year's marks (at least 50%) and attendance (at least 75%).
Submit the renewal before 31 Oct 2026 (NSP shows renewals open till 31-10-2026; institute verification till 15-11-2026).
kits.safety: Lookout never submits forms and never asks for, enters or stores passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar numbers.
notes: UNCLEAR: the FAQ says renewal runs 'up to Post Graduate level (except for the students pursuing technical courses leading to degree at graduation level)', but guideline section 7 pays B.Tech students Rs 12,000 in years 1-3 and Rs 20,000 in year 4. Verify which applies before telling a B.Tech student to renew.
Rate per guideline 7: Rs 12,000 per year for years 1-3 of B.Tech, Rs 20,000 in year 4.

steps: Check you fall into one of the four Swanath categories AND family income is at most Rs 8 lakh. This scheme is for those circumstances only.
Check you are not receiving any other Central, State or AICTE scholarship (2.0(4)).
Apply on NSP with your OTR and upload the documents for your category.
